purpose: Public due-diligence contract for reviewing third-party externalities, affected-party standing, remedy paths, and ethical-trade standards before Moral Trade proposals become relied upon.

dueDiligenceSteps.label: Embed policy
dueDiligenceSteps.rule: State the policy boundary, affected-party scope, and reviewer authority before evaluation.

dueDiligenceSteps.label: Identify impacts
dueDiligenceSteps.rule: Name actual or plausible impacts on unrepresented people, vulnerable parties, labor, communities, or ecosystems.

dueDiligenceSteps.label: Prevent or mitigate
dueDiligenceSteps.rule: Document how the proposal prevents, mitigates, or avoids worsening identified impacts.

dueDiligenceSteps.label: Track results
dueDiligenceSteps.rule: Track evidence, challenge-window outcomes, and unresolved externality flags.

dueDiligenceSteps.label: Communicate
dueDiligenceSteps.rule: Publish only privacy-safe reason codes and aggregate outcomes, not private evidence.

dueDiligenceSteps.label: Remediate
dueDiligenceSteps.rule: Define appeal, correction, pause, blocked, or unresolved-dispute paths when impacts are substantiated.

triggerCodes.label: Unrepresented third party
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review when a trade materially affects people who are not participants.

triggerCodes.label: Vulnerable-party pressure
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review when a paid action, disclosure, or pledge may pressure a vulnerable person or group.

triggerCodes.label: Political or campaign-adjacent
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review for political-adjacent proposals and block direct campaign contribution offsets elsewhere.

triggerCodes.label: Paid-action pressure
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review when compensation could distort voluntariness, labor conditions, or baseline incentives.

triggerCodes.label: Labor or supply-chain claim
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review when a proposal makes ethical-trade, sourcing, labor, or supplier claims.

triggerCodes.label: Recipient or destination risk
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review when money, action, or reputation flows to an organization with contested governance or harm risks.

triggerCodes.label: Environmental or community impact
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review when a project may affect local communities, pollution, land, animals, or ecosystems.

triggerCodes.label: Perverse incentive
triggerCodes.rule: Trigger review when the trade may reward newly escalated or strategically worsened behavior.

reviewStandards.label: OECD due diligence
reviewStandards.scope: General six-step policy, impact, mitigation, tracking, communication, and remediation review.

reviewStandards.label: UN Guiding Principles
reviewStandards.scope: Human-rights impact, remedy, and affected-party review.

reviewStandards.label: ILO Fundamental Principles
reviewStandards.scope: Labor rights, forced labor, child labor, discrimination, association, and workplace standing.

reviewStandards.label: ETI Base Code
reviewStandards.scope: Practical labor and supplier condition checks for ethical-trade claims.

reviewStandards.label: Fairtrade Standards
reviewStandards.scope: Destination, producer, and certification-style claims when fair-trade language is used.

reviewStandards.label: Open Supply Hub orientation
reviewStandards.scope: Identifier, deduplication, and public traceability discipline for supplier-like entities.

remedyControls.label: Affected-party standing
remedyControls.rule: Externality review must state who can challenge the trade and what standing they need.

remedyControls.label: Remediation plan
remedyControls.rule: The record must include pause, correction, reversal, appeal, or unresolved-dispute paths.

remedyControls.label: Challenge window required
remedyControls.rule: Material externality triggers route to challenge_window before reviewed completion or reputation reliance.

remedyControls.label: Privacy-safe reporting
remedyControls.rule: Public reporting uses reason codes, counts, and aggregate outcomes rather than private evidence.
